description: The file contains C source code implementing utility functions for a data model database component in a TR-069/CWMP environment. It provides parsing functions for data types, syntax, and enumeration tokens, as well as management of variable and object record arrays used in the data model.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS DslhWmpdoParseParamDataType(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,char * pDataTypeName,PULONG pulDataType,PULONG pulFormatValue1,PULONG pulFormatValue2,char ** ppEnumTokens)
methods.description: Parses a parameter's data type string to determine the type, format values, and optional enum tokens. Handles special base64 type, enumerated strings, and primitive types like string, int, unsignedInt, boolean, dateTime.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS DslhWmpdoParseParamSyntax(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,char * pSyntaxString,PULONG pulSyntax,PULONG pulContentType)
methods.description: Parses a parameter's syntax string to identify the syntax type and content type, mapping syntax tokens like bool, int, string, etc., and content tokens like MAPPED, IP4_ADDR, etc.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS DslhWmpdoParseParamEnumTokens(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hVarEntity,char * pEnumTokens)
methods.description: Processes an enumeration token string (e.g., 'string: Normal(1), UseAllocatedSubnet(2)') to extract tokens and their associated integer values, recording them in the variable entity.

methods.name: ULONG DslhWmpdoAddVarRecordIntoArray(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hVarRecord)
methods.description: Adds a variable record object into the database's variable record array, incrementing the count if not exceeded.

methods.name: ULONG DslhWmpdoAddObjRecordIntoArray(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hObjRecord)
methods.description: Adds an object record to the database object record array if it is not already present.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS DslhWmpdoInitObjVarArray(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Initializes the object and variable record arrays for setting parameter values, allocating necessary memory.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS DslhWmpdoResetObjVarArray(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Resets and frees the object and variable record arrays, preparing for reuse.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS DslhWmpdoFlushDynObjVar(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hDynObjRecord)
methods.description: Removes variable and object records associated with a specified dynamic object record from the arrays.
